Definition
[Transverse measure] 1. Definition 8.6\group measured laminationsSource: thurston:page-0204 For a lamination with local transverse spaces $B_i$, a transverse measure is a measure on each $B_i$, finite on compact transversals, invariant under the transverse coordinate changes. Equivalently it is a measure on every transversal, supported on the lamination and invariant under projection along leaves.
